findings.text: The new `DeclaredType` docstring no longer says why the model keeps the type spelling apart from the affinity; the old text gave that reason, which is the rowid trap (a BIGINT primary key does not alias the rowid, but INTEGER does). Fix: say that the model keeps the spelling because it decides whether a primary-key column aliases the rowid.

The new `Column.plain` docstring says what the test checks but not why: `Execution.lean` uses it to admit only plain columns in CREATE TABLE and ADD COLUMN. Fix: say that the supported subset admits only plain columns in created and added columns, so the model does not need NOT NULL, defaults or alias spellings there.
